_schema._description: Blog post data structure reference (this object is ignored by the app)
_schema.slug: string - URL slug, must match filename in blog-posts/*.html
_schema.title: string - Post title
_schema.excerpt: string - Brief summary for cards and meta description
_schema.author: string - Author name (optional)
tags: string array - Categories/tags for the post
_schema.published: boolean - Set false to hide post
